smap.config.alarm.value: causal, at the K-th consecutive step with p <= alpha_eff

smap.config.calibration.value: out-of-fold scores, 5 contiguous blocks, 30-window purge on each side; test scores from the full-training fit (cross-conformal approximation, Vovk 2015); chronos2 is zero-shot, so its training-series scores are used directly (split conformal)

smap.config.near_zero_spread.value: sd of the out-of-fold calibration scores < 1e-06 (ar_ridge: constant training target; pca, knn: constant training series)

smap.config.saturation.value: alarm on more than 0.9 of the test steps (label-free)

smap.config.subsets.attainable.value: channels where alpha_eff == alpha for every detector

smap.config.subsets.nondegenerate.value: unsaturated channels where no detector has near-zero spread

smap.config.subsets.note.value: channel sets common to every detector (per_channel.csv flags; summary suffixes)

smap.config.event_fp.value: maximal alarm segments outside every labelled sequence

smap.config.esa_ew_precision.value: TP / (TP + alarm runs touching no sequence) * (1 - nominal_alarm_fraction)

smap.config.reference.value: always_on: in alarm on every test step

smap.config.surrogates.value: 200 label-free alarms per channel and detector built from its alarms; shift: circularly shifted by a uniform offset; block: one block of its alarm time at a uniform start (both position-uniform); swap: the alarms reassigned among the channels of the spacecraft by a uniform random permutation, each stretched to its new channel's length by relative position (keeps the alarm positions; the null for channel-specific detection); late: one block of its alarm time at the end of the series (one draw, a reference; no p-value); *_<kind>: mean pooled metric; *_<kind>_p: (1 + #{surrogate >= detector}) / (draws + 1)

smap.config.pointwise_steps.value: test steps where telemanom has scores (250 .. n_test - 10), for every detector

smap.config.pointwise_auc_pr.value: mean over channels of the per-channel AUC-PR

smap.config.pointwise_auc_pr_pooled.value: pooled steps; each channel's scores mapped to conformal p-values against its out-of-fold training scores; steps above every calibration score tie at 1 / (n_cal + 1), so saturated or near-zero-spread channels fill the top of the ranking (ordered by n_cal); not for telemanom

smap.config.pointwise_auc_pr_pooled_raw.value: telemanom only (no training scores): pooled raw errors, the published convention

smap.config.point_adjusted_f1.value: on the pointwise steps; for contrast only

smap.config.note.value: thresholds fixed a priori; no test labels used for any choice

twin.verification.value: compare with decays in a later CelesTrak SATCAT snapshot
